name: SOLIZE Holdings Corporation
summary: SOLIZE Corporation provides engineering and design services worldwide, covering 3D printing, innovation engineering, CAE, MBD and 3D CAD, to clients in Japan, North America, China, India and Europe. It serves industries such as automotive, consumer electronics, medical equipment, energy, heavy industry, construction, aerospace, software, finance and business process outsourcing. Dating from 1990, it has its base in Chiyoda, Japan.
